<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>MAK-WebInnov</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<meta name="description" content="MAK-WebInnov, agence d'innovation web et digitale  : logiciels, applications mobiles et desktop, UI/UX design et marketing numérique.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Sora:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
<script>
  tailwind.config = {
    theme: {
      extend: {
        fontFamily: {
          display: ['Sora', 'ui-sans-serif', 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'sans-serif'],
          body: ['Plus Jakarta Sans', 'ui-sans-serif', 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'sans-serif']
        }
      }
    }
  };
</script>
<style>
  /* Concept : une aurore bleue et verte derrière des cartes en verre dépoli, façon iOS. Barre de navigation flottante en pilule, grands rayons, un seul moment de lumière animée. */
  :root {
    --bg: #E9F0FA;
    --bg-2: #F5F9FF;
    --fg: #0A1222;
    --muted: #46546E;
    --brand: #0088F2;
    --brand-ink: #0067C6;
    --accent: #10B981;
    --accent-ink: #047857;
    --g1: #0072D2;
    --g2: #058A62;
    --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55);
    --glass-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .80);
    --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .85);
    --glass-hi: rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
    --shadow: 0 14px 44px -16px rgba(0, 70, 150, .28);
    --blob-a: rgba(0, 136, 242, .42);
    --blob-b: rgba(16, 185, 129, .36);
    --blob-c: rgba(90, 170, 255, .34);
    --field: rgba(255, 255, 255, .75);
    --danger: #C0262D;
    --font-display: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    --font-body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
      --bg: #060A14;
      --bg-2: #0A1020;
      --fg: #EAF1FB;
      --muted: #A0AFC8;
      --brand: #2EA0FF;
      --brand-ink: #62B8FF;
      --accent: #34D399;
      --accent-ink: #4ADE9F;
      --g1: #55B6FF;
      --g2: #4ADE9F;
      --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07);
      --glass-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
      --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16);
      --glass-hi: rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
      --shadow: 0 22px 54px -22px rgba(0, 0, 0, .75);
      --blob-a: rgba(0, 136, 242, .32);
      --blob-b: rgba(16, 185, 129, .24);
      --blob-c: rgba(60, 120, 220, .26);
      --field: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
      --danger: #FF8F89;
      color-scheme: dark;
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg: #060A14;
    --bg-2: #0A1020;
    --fg: #EAF1FB;
    --muted: #A0AFC8;
    --brand: #2EA0FF;
    --brand-ink: #62B8FF;
    --accent: #34D399;
    --accent-ink: #4ADE9F;
    --g1: #55B6FF;
    --g2: #4ADE9F;
    --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07);
    --glass-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
    --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16);
    --glass-hi: rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
    --shadow: 0 22px 54px -22px rgba(0, 0, 0, .75);
    --blob-a: rgba(0, 136, 242, .32);
    --blob-b: rgba(16, 185, 129, .24);
    --blob-c: rgba(60, 120, 220, .26);
    --field: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --danger: #FF8F89;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  img { max-width: 100%; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--fg);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    padding-block: 0;
    padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
    padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
    overflow-x: clip;
  }
  body::before {
    content: "";
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0 0 auto;
    height: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    z-index: 70;
    background: var(--bg);
  }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.02em; text-wrap: balance; margin: 0; line-height: 1.12; }
  p { margin: 0; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 12px; }

  /* Aurore animée */
  .aurora { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-2), var(--bg)); }
  .blob { position: absolute; border-radius: 9999px; filter: blur(70px); will-change: transform; }
  .blob.a { width: 48vmax; height: 48vmax; left: -14vmax; top: -16vmax; background: var(--blob-a); animation: driftA 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .blob.b { width: 42vmax; height: 42vmax; right: -16vmax; top: 16vh; background: var(--blob-b); animation: driftB 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .blob.c { width: 36vmax; height: 36vmax; left: 18vw; bottom: -20vmax; background: var(--blob-c); animation: driftC 32s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes driftA { to { transform: translate3d(14vmax, 10vmax, 0) scale(1.12); } }
  @keyframes driftB { to { transform: translate3d(-12vmax, 12vmax, 0) scale(.92); } }
  @keyframes driftC { to { transform: translate3d(10vmax, -10vmax, 0) scale(1.1); } }
  .page { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

  /* Verre dépoli */
  .glass {
    background: var(--glass);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(170%);
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(170%);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow), inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-hi);
  }
  .glass-strong { background: var(--glass-strong); }
  @supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px))) {
    .glass { background: var(--glass-strong); }
  }

  .wrap { max-width: 1160px; margin-inline: auto; }
  .section { padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6.5rem); scroll-margin-top: 90px; }
  .eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--brand-ink); }
  .eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 22px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand), var(--accent)); }
  .h2 { font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4.2vw, 2.9rem); font-weight: 700; }
  .lead { color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.6vw, 1.125rem); max-width: 60ch; }
  .muted { color: var(--muted); }
  .grad { background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--g1), var(--g2)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }

  /* Boutons */
  .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .55rem; min-height: 48px; padding: .75rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.2; }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }
  .btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
  .btn-primary { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A8DF7, #0067C6); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -10px rgba(0, 136, 242, .7); }
  .btn-glass { color: var(--fg); background: var(--glass-strong); border-color: var(--glass-border); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); }
  .btn-wa { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0E9F6E, #047857); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -10px rgba(4, 120, 87, .7); }
  .btn-sm { min-height: 42px; padding: .5rem 1rem; font-size: .88rem; }

  .iconbtn { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; background: var(--glass-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); color: var(--fg); cursor: pointer; flex: none; transition: transform .2s ease; }
  .iconbtn:hover { transform: scale(1.06); }
  .iconbtn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

  /* Navigation flottante */
  .navwrap { position: fixed; z-index: 60; top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 12px); left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); pointer-events: none; }
  .navpill { pointer-events: auto; max-width: 1040px; margin-inline: auto; border-radius: 9999px; padding: .45rem .5rem .45rem .6rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; }
  .brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; min-width: 0; }
  .brand-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; white-space: nowrap; }
  .logo-tile { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--glass-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); flex: none; }
  .logo-tile svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
  /* Logo de l'en-tête : MAK en haut, Web · Innov en bas. Fond sombre fixe pour garder le blanc lisible en mode clair comme en mode sombre. */
  .lockup { font-size: .8rem; gap: .6em; padding: .4em .95em .4em .45em; border-radius: 1.25em; background: #070C18; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .14); }
  .lockup.lg { font-size: 1rem; }
  .lockup-icon { width: 2.5em; height: 2.5em; flex: none; }
  .wordmark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .14em; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1em; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.01em; white-space: nowrap; }
  .wm-top { color: #fff; }
  .wm-bottom { display: flex; align-items: baseline; color: #fff; }
  .wm-dot { width: .4em; height: .4em; margin: 0 .22em; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #9ADBFF, #0088F2 70%); position: relative; top: -.06em; flex: none; }
  .wm-red { color: #EC2B30; }
  /* Reflet mauve : un passage lent d'environ 1,6 s, puis 2 s de pause avant le suivant (cycle de 3,6 s). */
  .lockup { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .lockup::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: screen; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 30%, rgba(168, 85, 247, .5) 44%, rgba(226, 205, 255, .8) 50%, rgba(168, 85, 247, .5) 56%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-120%); will-change: transform; animation: lockShine 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes lockShine { 0% { transform: translateX(-120%); } 44% { transform: translateX(120%); } 100% { transform: translateX(120%); } }
  .navlinks a { padding: .5rem .9rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted); transition: background .2s, color .2s; }
  .navlinks a:hover, .navlinks a.active { background: var(--glass-strong); color: var(--fg); }
  .sheet { pointer-events: auto; max-width: 1040px; margin: .5rem auto 0; border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: .6rem; display: grid; gap: .15rem; }
  .sheet a { padding: .85rem 1rem; border-radius: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .sheet a:hover { background: var(--glass-strong); }
  .themebtn .i-moon { display: none; }
  .themebtn[data-mode="dark"] .i-sun { display: none; }
  .themebtn[data-mode="dark"] .i-moon { display: block; }
  #menu-btn .i-close { display: none; }
  #menu-btn[data-open="1"] .i-menu { display: none; }
  #menu-btn[data-open="1"] .i-close { display: block; }

  /* Hero */
  .hero { padding-top: 7.5rem; padding-bottom: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem); }
  .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; padding: .4rem .9rem .4rem .5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .pill .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, .25); }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(2.35rem, 6.2vw, 4.3rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.06; }
  .float-a { animation: floaty 7s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .float-b { animation: floaty 8s ease-in-out -2s infinite; }
  .float-c { animation: floaty 9s ease-in-out -4s infinite; }
  .portrait { animation: portraitFloat 9s ease-in-out infinite; will-change: transform; }
  @keyframes portraitFloat { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-14px) rotate(.4deg); } }
  @keyframes floaty { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } }
  .skel { height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--glass-strong); }
  .mock-hero { border-radius: 1.4rem; padding: 1.25rem; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A84F0, #0B8F68); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .9rem 1.1rem; }
  .chipfloat { position: absolute; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .5rem .9rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
  .chipfloat svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--brand-ink); }

  /* Cartes services */
  .tile { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A84F0, #0B8F68); flex: none; }
  .tile svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .tile.alt { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0B8F68, #0A84F0); }
  .lift { transition: transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease; }
  .lift:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); }
  .tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: .18rem .65rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: rgba(0, 136, 242, .14); color: var(--brand-ink); }
  .sample { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: .16rem .6rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px dashed var(--muted); color: var(--muted); }
  .link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: .92rem; color: var(--brand-ink); }
  .link-arrow svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform .2s; }
  .link-arrow:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); }

  /* Portfolio */
  .chip { padding: .55rem 1.15rem; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; font-family: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); background: var(--glass); color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
  .chip:hover { color: var(--fg); }
  .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A8DF7, #0067C6); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; }
  .thumb-btn { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: zoom-in; border-radius: 1.4rem; font: inherit; color: inherit; }
  .thumb { display: block; position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 1.4rem; overflow: hidden; background: var(--glass-strong); }
  .thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; max-width: none; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform .5s ease; }
  .thumb-btn:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
  .viewer { padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: 1.75rem; width: min(92vw, 720px); max-height: 92vh; overflow: auto; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-2); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  .viewer::backdrop { background: rgba(6, 10, 20, .62); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
  .viewer img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 68vh; object-fit: contain; background: var(--bg); }
  .viewer-cap { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; }
  .viewer-close { position: absolute; top: .75rem; right: .75rem; z-index: 2; }
  .mk-browser { width: 78%; height: 74%; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .9); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .mk-bar { height: 15px; background: rgba(10, 18, 34, .09); display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; }
  .mk-bar i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(10, 18, 34, .32); }
  .mk-body { flex: 1; padding: 8px; display: grid; gap: 6px; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; }
  .mk-hero { height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--t1), var(--t2)); }
  .mk-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
  .mk-cards b { border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(10, 18, 34, .09); }
  .mk-phone { height: 88%; aspect-ratio: 9 / 17; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .93); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); padding: 9px; display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; }
  .mk-row { height: 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(10, 18, 34, .09); }
  .mk-row.hl { height: 30px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--t1), var(--t2)); }
  .mk-design { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: #fff; }
  .mk-design .aa { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 7vw, 3.4rem); line-height: 1; }
  .mk-design .sw { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 28px); gap: 6px; }
  .mk-design .sw i { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .85); }
  .mk-design .sw i:nth-child(2) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .45); }
  .mk-design .sw i:nth-child(3) { background: rgba(10, 18, 34, .55); }
  .mk-design .sw i:nth-child(4) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .22); }

  /* Témoignages */
  .track { display: flex; gap: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; padding: .5rem .25rem 1.5rem; scrollbar-width: none; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
  .track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .tcard { flex: 0 0 min(88%, 380px); scroll-snap-align: start; border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: 1.6rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.1rem; min-width: 0; }
  .avatar { object-fit: cover; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 9999px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A84F0, #0B8F68); flex: none; }
  .qmark { width: 34px; height: 34px; color: var(--brand); opacity: .85; }

  /* Développeur */
  .portrait { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 2rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(150deg, #0A84F0 0%, #0B7FBF 45%, #0B8F68 100%); }
  .portrait img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; max-width: none; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 18%; display: block; }
  .monogram { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(4rem, 12vw, 6.5rem); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .95); letter-spacing: -.04em; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .skill { display: inline-flex; padding: .4rem .9rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; background: var(--glass-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); }

  /* Contact */
  .cinfo { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: flex-start; border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: 1.25rem; min-width: 0; }
  .cinfo .val { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; word-break: break-word; user-select: all; }
  .field { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: .8rem 1rem; border-radius: 1.1rem; background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); color: var(--fg); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; }
  .field::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: .75; }
  .field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger); }
  textarea.field { min-height: 140px; resize: vertical; }
  .lbl { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: .4rem; }
  .err { color: var(--danger); font-size: .84rem; min-height: 1.3em; margin-top: .25rem; }
  .status { border-radius: 1.1rem; padding: .85rem 1rem; font-size: .92rem; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); background: var(--glass-strong); }
  .status.ok { border-color: var(--accent); }
  .status.warn { border-color: var(--brand); }
  .status.err { border-color: #ef4444; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, .1); font-weight: 600; }
  #t-status { font-weight: 600; }

  /* WhatsApp flottant */
  .wa-fab-wrap { position: fixed; z-index: 55; right: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: .75rem; }
  .wa-fab { position: relative; isolation: isolate; width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 9999px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0E9F6E, #047857); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -8px rgba(4, 120, 87, .75); transition: transform .2s ease; }
  .wa-fab:hover { transform: scale(1.07); }
  .wa-fab svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
  .wa-fab::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #10B981; opacity: .55; z-index: -1; animation: ping 2.2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1) infinite; }
  @keyframes ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(1.9); opacity: 0; } }
  .wa-tip { position: relative; max-width: min(270px, calc(100vw - 100px)); border-radius: 1.4rem; padding: .9rem 2.4rem .9rem 1rem; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.45; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(.96); transform-origin: bottom right; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease; }
  .wa-tip.show { opacity: 1; transform: none; pointer-events: auto; }
  .wa-tip strong { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); }
  .wa-tip button { position: absolute; top: .45rem; right: .45rem; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .wa-tip button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

  .toast { position: fixed; z-index: 80; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); bottom: calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); padding: .7rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600; }

  footer a:hover { color: var(--brand-ink); }
  .ico { width: 24px; height: 24px; }


  .soc { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; color: var(--fg); background: var(--glass-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); transition: transform .2s ease; }
  .soc:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
  .soc svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .soc.wa { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0E9F6E, #047857); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -10px rgba(4, 120, 87, .7); }

  /* Accueil : message qui s'écrit et s'efface */
  .typer { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.4rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2.5vw, 1.4rem); letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--brand-ink); }
  .typer .caret { display: inline-block; width: 3px; height: 1.15em; margin-left: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent); animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

  /* Fusée en fond du titre : 2 s au sol, décollage, atterrissage (cycle de 5,6 s) */
  .hero-copy { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
  .rocket-bg { position: absolute; z-index: -1; right: 2%; top: 7rem; width: clamp(96px, 20vw, 170px); opacity: .2; pointer-events: none; }
  .rocket { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; animation: rocketFly 5.6s infinite; }
  .rocket-flame { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 0%; animation: rocketFlame 5.6s infinite; }
  @keyframes rocketFly {
    0%, 36% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.55, 0, .9, .45); }
    68% { transform: translate(16px, -110px) rotate(5deg); animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .4, 1); }
    100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
  }
  @keyframes rocketFlame {
    0%, 34% { opacity: 0; transform: scaleY(.4); }
    40% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1); }
    52% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(.78); }
    64% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1); }
    72%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scaleY(.4); }
  }

  /* À propos : « Nous sommes » */
  .nous { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2.6vw, 1.4rem); letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--brand-ink); }
  .nous-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: .9rem; }
  .nous-list li { position: relative; padding-left: 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.6vw, 1.08rem); line-height: 1.6; max-width: 62ch; }
  .nous-list li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: .62em; width: .6rem; height: .6rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand), var(--accent)); }

  /* Retrouvez-moi */
  .retro { max-width: 400px; margin-inline: auto; border-radius: 1.6rem; padding: 1rem 1rem 1rem; display: grid; gap: .8rem; text-align: center; border-color: rgba(0, 136, 242, .42); }
  .retrouvez { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin: 0; line-height: 1.3; }
  .soc-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; }
  .soc-row .soc { flex: 0 1 50px; width: auto; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; min-width: 0; }
  .soc-row .soc svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .soc-mini { justify-content: flex-start; gap: .4rem; }
  .soc-mini .soc { flex: 0 0 34px; width: 34px; height: 34px; }
  .soc-mini .soc svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
  .btn-xl { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; font-size: clamp(.95rem, 4vw, 1.05rem); gap: .6rem; padding-block: .55rem; }
  .btn-xl svg { width: 1.3em; height: 1.3em; }
  .retro .btn-wa { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38B964, #2C8E80); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -12px rgba(44, 142, 128, .8); }
  #contact-form { scroll-margin-top: 96px; }

  /* À propos : chiffres clés */
  .stat { border-radius: 1.4rem; padding: 1.1rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .3rem; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); }
  .stat strong { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.2rem); line-height: 1.05; background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--g1), var(--g2)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
  .stat span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.4; }

  /* Services : puces de points forts */
  .ticks { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: .55rem; }
  .ticks li { display: flex; gap: .65rem; align-items: flex-start; font-size: .94rem; line-height: 1.45; }
  .ticks li > span:last-child { min-width: 0; }
  .chk { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 9999px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; margin-top: .05rem; color: var(--accent-ink); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, .16); }
  .chk svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

  /* Témoignages : note en étoiles */
  .stars { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: row-reverse; gap: .1rem; }
  .stars input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; }
  .stars label { cursor: pointer; padding: .25rem; color: var(--muted); opacity: .55; line-height: 0; transition: color .15s, opacity .15s, transform .15s; }
  .stars label svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; fill: currentColor; }
  .stars label:hover, .stars label:hover ~ label, .stars input:checked ~ label { color: #F5A524; opacity: 1; }
  .stars label:hover { transform: scale(1.08); }
  .stars input:focus-visible + label { outline: 3px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 10px; }
  .stars-ro { display: inline-flex; gap: .1rem; }
  .stars-ro span { line-height: 0; color: var(--muted); opacity: .45; }
  .stars-ro span.on { color: #F5A524; opacity: 1; }
  .stars-ro svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    .blob, .float-a, .float-b, .float-c, .wa-fab::before, .lockup::after, .typer .caret, .rocket, .rocket-flame, .portrait { animation: none; }
    .lift, .btn, .wa-tip, .soc, .thumb img { transition: none; }
  }

  /* Écran de chargement */
  #loader { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 200; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, #12233f 0%, #070C18 70%); color: #fff; transition: opacity .55s ease, visibility .55s ease; animation: loaderFailsafe .4s 9s forwards; }
  #loader.done { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
  @keyframes loaderFailsafe { to { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; } }
  .ld-inner { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 1.1rem; width: min(320px, 100%); text-align: center; }
  .ld-ring { position: relative; width: 168px; height: 168px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; }
  .ld-ring > svg.rings { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; }
  .ld-ring .g { transform-origin: 84px 84px; }
  .ld-ring .r1 { animation: ldSpin 1.6s linear infinite; }
  .ld-ring .r2 { animation: ldSpin 2.6s linear infinite reverse; }
  .ld-ring .orb { animation: ldSpin 14s linear infinite; }
  .ld-ring circle { fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; }
  .ld-ring .t { stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); stroke-width: 2; }
  .ld-ring .a1 { stroke: url(#ldg); stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 120 295; }
  .ld-ring .a2 { stroke: #10B981; stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 70 245; opacity: .9; }
  .ld-ring .trail { stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 34 440; }
  .ld-ring .logo { position: relative; width: 62px; height: 62px; background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 0; animation: ldPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes ldSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes ldPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.07); } }
  .ld-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.7rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin: 0; }
  .ld-title b { font-weight: 700; color: #ff4d4d; }
  .ld-title .w { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4db3ff, #34d399); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
  .ld-sub { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .62); }
  .ld-bar { width: 100%; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12); overflow: hidden; }
  .ld-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0088F2, #10B981); }
  .ld-pct { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .9rem; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ld-ring .logo, .ld-ring .r1, .ld-ring .r2, .ld-ring .orb { animation: none; } #loader { transition: none; } }


  /* Animation des deux boutons du haut (jour/nuit et menu) */
  .iconbtn.hop { animation: btnHop .65s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes btnHop { 0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } 35% { transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1.1); } 70% { transform: translateY(2px) scale(.97); } 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
  .themebtn.hop .i-sun { animation: iconSpin .65s ease-out; }
  .themebtn.hop .i-moon { animation: iconSpinR .65s ease-out; }
  #menu-btn.hop .i-menu, #menu-btn.hop .i-close { animation: iconSpin .5s ease-out; }
  @keyframes iconSpin { from { transform: rotate(-180deg) scale(.4); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes iconSpinR { from { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(.4); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .iconbtn.hop, .iconbtn.hop svg { animation: none; } }

  /* Apparition au défilement */
  html.rv-on .rv { opacity: 0; translate: 0 34px; transition: opacity .75s cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1), translate .75s cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1); transition-delay: var(--rvd, 0ms); }
  html.rv-on .rv.in { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; }
  html.rv-on .rv.rv-l { translate: -34px 0; }
  html.rv-on .rv.rv-r { translate: 34px 0; }
  html.rv-on .rv.in.rv-l, html.rv-on .rv.in.rv-r { translate: 0 0; }
</style>
</head>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var $ = function (s, r) { return (r || document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function (s, r) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
  document.documentElement.lang = 'fr';

  /* ===== Écran de chargement 0 → 100 % ===== */
  (function () {
    var L = $('#loader');
    if (!L) return;
    var bar = $('#ld-bar'), pct = $('#ld-pct');
    var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    var MIN = reduce ? 700 : 3500, MAX = 6000, t0 = Date.now(), loaded = document.readyState === 'complete', finished = false;
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    window.addEventListener('load', function () { loaded = true; });
    function set(n) {
      n = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Math.round(n)));
      pct.textContent = n + '%';
      bar.style.width = n + '%';
    }
    function end() {
      if (finished) return;
      finished = true;
      L.classList.add('done');
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
      setTimeout(function () { if (L.parentNode) L.parentNode.removeChild(L); }, 700);
    }
    (function step() {
      var el = Date.now() - t0;
      var p = Math.min(1, el / MIN);
      var eased = p < .5 ? 2 * p * p : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * p + 2, 2) / 2;
      var v = eased * 100;
      if (!loaded && el < MAX) v = Math.min(v, 92);
      set(v);
      if (v >= 100) { setTimeout(end, 350); return; }
      if (el >= MAX) { set(100); setTimeout(end, 350); return; }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    })();
  })();


  /* ===== Configuration ===== */
  // Web3Forms : créez une clé gratuite sur https://web3forms.com avec benmalwasa3@gmail.com,
  // puis collez-la ici. Tant que la clé n'est pas remplacée, le formulaire utilise mailto.
  var WEB3FORMS_KEY = 'VOTRE_CLE_ACCES_WEB3FORMS';
  /* WhatsApp silencieux (facultatif) : CALLMEBOT_PHONE = votre numéro sans « + », CALLMEBOT_KEY = clé reçue de CallMeBot. */
  var CALLMEBOT_PHONE = '243812853824';
  var CALLMEBOT_KEY = 'VOTRE_CLE_CALLMEBOT';
  var MAIL_TO = 'benmalwasa3@gmail.com';

  /* ===== Animation des boutons du haut ===== */
  function hop(btn) {
    btn.classList.remove('hop');
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add('hop');
    setTimeout(function () { btn.classList.remove('hop'); }, 750);
  }

  /* ===== Thème clair / sombre ===== */
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
  function effective() {
    var a = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    if (a === 'dark' || a === 'light') return a;
    return mq.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }
  function syncThemeBtn() {
    var m = effective();
    var b = $('#theme-toggle');
    b.setAttribute('data-mode', m);
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', m === 'dark' ? 'Passer en mode clair' : 'Passer en mode sombre');
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(m === 'dark'));
  }
  try {
    var saved = localStorage.getItem('mak-theme');
    if (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light') root.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
  } catch (e) {}
  $('#theme-toggle').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var next = effective() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    hop(this);
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    try { localStorage.setItem('mak-theme', next); } catch (e) {}
    syncThemeBtn();
  });
  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', syncThemeBtn);
  syncThemeBtn();

  /* ===== Menu mobile ===== */
  var menuBtn = $('#menu-btn'), sheet = $('#sheet');
  function setMenu(open) {
    sheet.hidden = !open;
    menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    menuBtn.setAttribute('data-open', open ? '1' : '0');
    menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Fermer le menu' : 'Ouvrir le menu');
  }
  menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { hop(menuBtn); setMenu(sheet.hidden); });
  $$('#sheet a').forEach(function (a) { a.addEventListener('click', function () { setMenu(false); }); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !sheet.hidden) { setMenu(false); menuBtn.focus(); }
  });

  /* ===== Lien actif au défilement ===== */
  var links = $$('#navlinks a');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var spy = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) {
          var id = '#' + en.target.id;
          links.forEach(function (l) { l.classList.toggle('active', l.getAttribute('href') === id); });
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '-40% 0px -55% 0px' });
    ['accueil', 'apropos', 'services', 'portfolio', 'temoignages', 'contact'].forEach(function (id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) spy.observe(el);
    });
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }

  /* ===== Portfolio ===== */
  var CAT = { web: 'Web', apps: 'Apps', design: 'Design' };
  var PROJECTS = [
    {"t": "Badman Forever Records", "c": "web", "d": "Site vitrine et menu digital pour un label de production musicale à Kinshasa.", "pos": "50% 50%", "img": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
    {"t": "BWALA Brand", "c": "apps", "d": "Application mobile de collection d'habits uniques, célébrant l'artisanat et l'originalité de nos aïeux.", "pos": "50% 50%", "img": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
    {"t": "Joas Studio", "c": "design", "d": "Identité visuelle et design system pour un studio créatif.", "pos": "50% 32%", "img": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
    {"t": "AliNoss Prestige", "c": "web", "d": "Plateforme de recherche immobilière avec visites virtuelles.", "pos": "50% 55%", "img": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"},
    {"t": "Vahana Cosmetics", "c": "design", "d": "Refonte UI/UX et packaging digital pour une marque de cosmétiques.", "pos": "50% 40%", "img": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}
  ];
  var grid = $('#projects');
  grid.innerHTML = PROJECTS.map(function (p, i) {
    return '<article class="glass lift rounded-3xl p-3" data-cat="' + p.c + '">' +
      '<button type="button" class="thumb-btn" data-i="' + i + '" aria-label="Agrandir l\'aperçu : ' + esc(p.t) + '">' +
      '<span class="thumb"><img src="' + p.img + '" alt="Aperçu du projet ' + esc(p.t) + '" style="object-position:' + p.pos + '" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span></button>' +
      '<div class="px-3 pb-3 pt-4"><span class="tag">' + CAT[p.c] + '</span>' +
      '<h3 class="mt-3 text-lg font-semibold">' + esc(p.t) + '</h3>' +
      '<p class="muted mt-1 text-sm">' + esc(p.d) + '</p></div></article>';
  }).join('');

  /* Aperçu agrandi */
  var viewer = $('#viewer');
  function closeViewer() { if (viewer.close) viewer.close(); else viewer.removeAttribute('open'); }
  function openViewer(i) {
    var p = PROJECTS[i];
    if (!p) return;
    var im = $('#viewer-img');
    im.src = p.img;
    im.alt = 'Aperçu du projet ' + p.t;
    $('#viewer-cat').textContent = CAT[p.c];
    $('#viewer-title').textContent = p.t;
    $('#viewer-desc').textContent = p.d;
    if (typeof viewer.showModal === 'function') viewer.showModal(); else viewer.setAttribute('open', '');
  }
  grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.thumb-btn') : null;
    if (b) openViewer(parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-i'), 10));
  });
  $('#viewer-close').addEventListener('click', closeViewer);
  viewer.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === viewer) closeViewer(); });
  var filterBtns = $$('#filters .chip');
  filterBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var f = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
      filterBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b === btn)); });
      var shown = 0;
      $$('#projects > article').forEach(function (card) {
        var show = f === 'all' || card.getAttribute('data-cat') === f;
        card.hidden = !show;
        if (show) shown++;
      });
      $('#filter-count').textContent = shown + (shown > 1 ? ' projets affichés' : ' projet affiché');
    });
  });

  /* ===== Témoignages ===== */
  /* Pour ajouter un vrai avis : { q: 'Le commentaire', n: 'Nom', r: 'Activité', rating: 5, img: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,…', real: true } */
  var TESTI = [
    { q: 'MAK-WebInnov a transformé notre présence en ligne. Le site est magnifique et nos réservations ont augmenté de 40 % en trois mois.', n: 'Alice Adikey', r: 'Fondatrice, AliNoss Prestige', img: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', real: true },
    { q: 'Une équipe à l\'écoute et très professionnelle. Notre application est fluide, rapide et nos utilisateurs en sont ravis.', n: 'Consolette Kitebi', r: 'Conseillère, Joas Studio', img: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', real: true },
    { q: 'Leur sens du détail est impressionnant. Le design est moderne, cohérent et parfaitement adapté à notre marque.', n: 'Vahana Malwasa', r: 'CEO, Vahana Cosmetics', img: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', real: true },
    { q: 'Nos clients adorent la nouvelle plateforme. Le travail a été livré dans les délais et le suivi a été irréprochable.', n: 'Joas Scott', r: 'CEO, BWALA Brand', img: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,', real: true }
  ];
  var track = $('#track');
  var STAR = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l2.7 5.6 6.1.9-4.4 4.3 1 6.1L12 17l-5.4 2.9 1-6.1L3.2 9.5l6.1-.9L12 3z"/></svg>';
  function starsRO(n) {
    var out = '';
    for (var i = 1; i <= 5; i++) out += '<span class="' + (i <= n ? 'on' : '') + '">' + STAR + '</span>';
    return '<span class="stars-ro" role="img" aria-label="Note : ' + n + ' sur 5">' + out + '</span>';
  }
  var QUOTE = '<svg class="qmark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9.5 6C6.5 7 4 9.8 4 13.5V18h6v-6H7c0-2 1-3.2 3-3.8L9.5 6zm9 0c-3 1-5.5 3.8-5.5 7.5V18h6v-6h-3c0-2 1-3.2 3-3.8L18.5 6z"/></svg>';
  function cardHTML(t) {
    var badge = t.pending ? 'En attente de validation' : (t.real ? '' : 'Exemple à remplacer');
    var av = t.img && /^(data:image\/|https:\/\/)/.test(t.img)
      ? '<img class="avatar" src="' + t.img + '" alt="Photo de ' + esc(t.n) + '" loading="lazy">'
      : '<span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">' + esc(t.n.charAt(0).toUpperCase()) + '</span>';
    return '<figure class="glass tcard lift" style="margin:0">' +
      '<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">' + (t.rating ? starsRO(t.rating) : QUOTE) +
      (badge ? '<span class="sample">' + badge + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
      '<blockquote style="margin:0;font-size:1.02rem">' + esc(t.q) + '</blockquote>' +
      '<figcaption class="mt-auto flex items-center gap-3">' + av +
      '<span class="min-w-0"><span class="block font-semibold">' + esc(t.n) + '</span>' +
      (t.r ? '<span class="muted text-sm">' + esc(t.r) + '</span>' : '') + '</span></figcaption></figure>';
  }
  track.innerHTML = TESTI.map(cardHTML).join('');
  function slide(dir) {
    var card = $('.tcard', track);
    var step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 320;
    track.scrollBy({ left: dir * step, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }
  $('#t-prev').addEventListener('click', function () { slide(-1); });
  $('#t-next').addEventListener('click', function () { slide(1); });

  /* ===== Formulaire d'avis ===== */
  var tForm = $('#t-form'), tStatus = $('#t-status'), tBtn = $('#t-submit');
  function tShow(kind, html) {
    tStatus.className = 'status mt-4 ' + kind;
    tStatus.innerHTML = html;
    tStatus.hidden = false;
  }
  function tErr(id, msg) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = msg; }
  function tRating() {
    var r = tForm.querySelector('input[name="rating"]:checked');
    return r ? parseInt(r.value, 10) : 0;
  }
  function tValidate() {
    var ok = true;
    var name = $('#t-name'), msg = $('#t-message');
    var nameOk = name.value.trim().length >= 2;
    name.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(!nameOk));
    tErr('e-t-name', nameOk ? '' : 'Entrez votre nom (2 caractères minimum).');
    var em = $('#t-email');
    var emOk = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(em.value.trim());
    em.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(!emOk));
    tErr('e-t-email', emOk ? '' : 'Entrez une adresse e-mail valide.');
    var rateOk = tRating() > 0;
    tErr('e-t-rating', rateOk ? '' : 'Choisissez une note de 1 à 5 étoiles.');
    var msgOk = msg.value.trim().length >= 15;
    msg.setAttribute('aria-invalid', String(!msgOk));
    tErr('e-t-message', msgOk ? '' : 'Votre avis doit contenir au moins 15 caractères.');
    if (!nameOk) { name.focus(); ok = false; }
    else if (!emOk) { em.focus(); ok = false; }
    else if (!rateOk) { var first = $('#t-stars input'); if (first) first.focus(); ok = false; }
    else if (!msgOk) { msg.focus(); ok = false; }
    if (!(nameOk && emOk && rateOk && msgOk)) ok = false;
    return ok;
  }
  ['t-name', 't-email', 't-message'].forEach(function (id) {
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input', function () {
      if (this.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true') this.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
    });
  });
  tForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (tForm.botcheck && tForm.botcheck.checked) return;
    tStatus.hidden = true;
    if (!tValidate()) { tShow('err', 'Merci de vérifier les champs surlignés avant l\'envoi.'); return; }
    var v = {
      name: $('#t-name').value.trim(),
      email: $('#t-email').value.trim(),
      role: $('#t-role').value.trim(),
      rating: tRating(),
      message: $('#t-message').value.trim()
    };
    var subject = 'Nouvel avis client : ' + v.rating + '/5 par ' + v.name;
    var text = 'Nom : ' + v.name + '\nE-mail : ' + v.email + '\nActivité : ' + (v.role || 'non précisée') + '\nNote : ' + v.rating + '/5\n\n' + v.message;
    function addCard() {
      track.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', cardHTML({ q: v.message, n: v.name, r: v.role, rating: v.rating, pending: true }));
      track.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      tForm.reset();
    }
    var hasKey = WEB3FORMS_KEY && WEB3FORMS_KEY.indexOf('VOTRE') !== 0;
    var hasCmb = CALLMEBOT_KEY && CALLMEBOT_KEY.indexOf('VOTRE') !== 0;
    var THANKS = 'Merci pour votre avis ! Il sera publié après validation par notre équipe.';
    function viaMail() {
      var href = 'mailto:' + MAIL_TO + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subject) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(text);
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = href;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      addCard();
      tShow('ok', THANKS + '<span class="mt-2 block text-sm font-normal">Pour finaliser, envoyez l\'e-mail qui vient de s\'ouvrir. Sinon, <a class="font-semibold underline" href="' + href + '">cliquez ici</a>.</span>');
    }
    if (hasCmb) {
      /* Copie silencieuse vers votre WhatsApp via CallMeBot (le visiteur ne voit rien). */
      fetch('https://api.callmebot.com/whatsapp.php?phone=' + CALLMEBOT_PHONE + '&apikey=' + encodeURIComponent(CALLMEBOT_KEY) +
        '&text=' + encodeURIComponent('Nouvel avis (' + v.rating + '/5)\n' + v.name + ' · ' + v.email + (v.role ? ' · ' + v.role : '') + '\n\n' + v.message), { mode: 'no-cors' })
        .catch(function () {});
    }
    viaMail();
  });

  /* ===== Notifications et copie ===== */
  var toastEl = $('#toast'), toastTimer;
  function toast(msg) {
    toastEl.textContent = msg;
    toastEl.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { toastEl.hidden = true; }, 2600);
  }
  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:0;opacity:0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    var ok = false;
    try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    return ok;
  }
  $$('[data-copy]').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var text = btn.getAttribute('data-copy');
      var done = function () { toast('Copié : ' + text); };
      var fail = function () {
        if (fallbackCopy(text)) done(); else toast('Sélectionnez le texte pour le copier.');
      };
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, fail);
      } else { fail(); }
    });
  });

  /* ===== Sujet pré-rempli depuis les services ===== */
  $$('[data-subject]').forEach(function (a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function () { $('#f-subject').value = a.getAttribute('data-subject'); });
  });

  /* ===== Formulaire de contact ===== */
  var form = $('#contact-form'), statusEl = $('#form-status'), submitBtn = $('#f-submit');
  var rules = {
    name: function (v) { return v.trim().length >= 2 || 'Entrez votre nom (2 caractères minimum).'; },
    email: function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(v.trim()) || 'Entrez une adresse e-mail valide.'; },
    subject: function (v) { return v.trim().length >= 3 || 'Indiquez un sujet (3 caractères minimum).'; },
    message: function (v) { return v.trim().length >= 10 || 'Votre message doit contenir au moins 10 caractères.'; }
  };
  var fieldIds = { name: 'f-name', email: 'f-email', subject: 'f-subject', message: 'f-message' };
  function check(name) {
    var input = document.getElementById(fieldIds[name]);
    var res = rules[name](input.value);
    var err = document.getElementById('e-' + name);
    var ok = res === true;
    err.textContent = ok ? '' : res;
    input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', ok ? 'false' : 'true');
    return ok;
  }
  Object.keys(rules).forEach(function (name) {
    var input = document.getElementById(fieldIds[name]);
    input.addEventListener('blur', function () { check(name); });
    input.addEventListener('input', function () { if (input.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true') check(name); });
  });
  function showStatus(kind, html) {
    statusEl.className = 'status mt-4 ' + kind;
    statusEl.style.fontWeight = '600';
    statusEl.innerHTML = html;
    statusEl.hidden = false;
  }
  function buildMailto(v) {
    var body = 'Nom : ' + v.name + '\nE-mail : ' + v.email + '\n\n' + v.message;
    return 'mailto:' + MAIL_TO + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(v.subject) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);
  }
  var SENT = 'Merci ! Votre message a bien été envoyé. Nous vous répondons sous 24 heures.';
  function openMail(v) {
    var href = buildMailto(v);
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = href;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    return href;
  }
  var sending = false;
  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (sending || (form.botcheck && form.botcheck.checked)) return;
    statusEl.hidden = true;
    var valid = true, firstBad = null;
    Object.keys(rules).forEach(function (name) {
      if (!check(name)) { valid = false; if (!firstBad) firstBad = name; }
    });
    if (!valid) {
      document.getElementById(fieldIds[firstBad]).focus();
      showStatus('err', 'Merci de vérifier les champs surlignés avant l\'envoi.');
      return;
    }
    var v = {
      name: $('#f-name').value.trim(),
      email: $('#f-email').value.trim(),
      subject: $('#f-subject').value.trim(),
      message: $('#f-message').value.trim()
    };
    var hasKey = WEB3FORMS_KEY && WEB3FORMS_KEY.indexOf('VOTRE') !== 0;
    var label = submitBtn.innerHTML;
    sending = true;
    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.style.opacity = '.75';
    submitBtn.textContent = 'Envoi en cours…';
    var wait = new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 2000); });
    var job = hasKey
      ? fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ access_key: WEB3FORMS_KEY, from_name: 'Site MAK-WebInnov', name: v.name, email: v.email, subject: v.subject, message: v.message })
        }).then(function (res) { return res.json(); }).then(function (d) { return !!(d && d.success); }).catch(function () { return false; })
      : Promise.resolve(false);
    Promise.all([job, wait]).then(function (r) {
      var extra = '';
      if (r[0]) {
        form.reset();
      } else {
        var href = openMail(v);
        extra = '<span class="mt-2 block text-sm font-normal">Pour finaliser, envoyez l\'e-mail qui vient de s\'ouvrir. Sinon, <a class="font-semibold underline" href="' + href + '">cliquez ici</a> ou écrivez-nous sur <a class="font-semibold underline" href="https://wa.me/243812853824" target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp</a>.</span>';
      }
      showStatus('ok', SENT + extra);
      submitBtn.innerHTML = label;
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      submitBtn.style.opacity = '';
      sending = false;
    });
  });

  /* ===== Info-bulle WhatsApp ===== */
  var tip = $('#wa-tip'), fab = $('#wa-fab'), tipTimer;
  var dismissed = false;
  try { dismissed = sessionStorage.getItem('mak-tip') === '1'; } catch (e) {}
  function showTip() { tip.classList.add('show'); }
  function hideTip() { tip.classList.remove('show'); }
  if (!dismissed) {
    setTimeout(function () { showTip(); tipTimer = setTimeout(hideTip, 9000); }, 2500);
  }
  $('#wa-tip-close').addEventListener('click', function () {
    hideTip();
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('mak-tip', '1'); } catch (e) {}
  });
  fab.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { clearTimeout(tipTimer); showTip(); });
  fab.addEventListener('focus', function () { clearTimeout(tipTimer); showTip(); });
  fab.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { tipTimer = setTimeout(hideTip, 3000); });

  /* ===== Message animé de l'accueil ===== */
  var typerEl = $('#typer-text');
  if (typerEl) {
    var PHRASES = ['On innove.', 'On crée.', 'On développe.', 'Contactez-nous.'];
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      typerEl.textContent = PHRASES.join(' ');
    } else {
      var pi = 0, ci = PHRASES[0].length, erasing = true;
      var tick = function () {
        var p = PHRASES[pi];
        if (!erasing) {
          ci++;
          typerEl.textContent = p.slice(0, ci);
          if (ci >= p.length) { erasing = true; setTimeout(tick, 1600); return; }
          setTimeout(tick, 85);
        } else {
          ci--;
          typerEl.textContent = p.slice(0, Math.max(ci, 0));
          if (ci <= 0) { erasing = false; pi = (pi + 1) % PHRASES.length; setTimeout(tick, 380); return; }
          setTimeout(tick, 45);
        }
      };
      setTimeout(tick, 1800);
    }
  }

  /* ===== Apparition progressive au défilement ===== */
  (function () {
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    var sel = 'section:not(#accueil) .eyebrow, section:not(#accueil) .h2, section:not(#accueil) .lead, section:not(#accueil) article, ' +
      'section:not(#accueil) .stat, section:not(#accueil) form, section:not(#accueil) .portrait, section:not(#accueil) .retro, ' +
      'section:not(#accueil) .nous, section:not(#accueil) .nous-list li, section:not(#accueil) .skill, section:not(#accueil) #track, ' +
      'section:not(#accueil) .soc-row, footer .glass';
    var els = $$(sel);
    var counts = new Map();
    els.forEach(function (el, i) {
      el.classList.add('rv');
      var par = el.parentNode, n = counts.get(par) || 0;
      counts.set(par, n + 1);
      el.style.setProperty('--rvd', Math.min(n * 100, 500) + 'ms');
      if (el.matches('.portrait')) el.classList.add('rv-l');
    });
    root.classList.add('rv-on');
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
        en.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(en.target);
        setTimeout(function () { en.target.classList.remove('rv'); en.target.style.removeProperty('--rvd'); }, 1600);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  })();

  $('#year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
